description.zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。
默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100.
Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

description.zh: 文件系统和虚拟存储通道的 ID 信息，每批次最多 10 个。
description.en: The ID information of file systems and virtual storage channels. A maximum of 10 entries can be specified per batch.

description.zh:
角色链。
>仅跨账号场景需要。
description.en:
The role chain.
>Required only for cross-account scenarios.

title.zh: 查询文件系统关联的虚拟存储通道信息
title.en: Query virtual storage channel information associated with a file system

descriptions.zh:
- 仅CPFS智算版支持该功能。
- 支持批量执行，批量执行情况下，目前仅支持1个VscId关联到多个FileSystemId，即ResourceIds.VscId需相等。
descriptions.en:
- Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this feature.
- Batch execution is supported. In batch execution mode, only one VscId can be associated with multiple FileSystemIds, which means the values of ResourceIds.VscId must be the same.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas describe-filesystems-vsc-attach-info --resource-ids VscId=vsc-8vb864o3ppwfvh0000 FileSystemId=bmcpfs-290t15yn4uo8lid0000 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cmNlU0000mVzJjE1MTI2NjY4NzY5MTAzOTEmMiZORnI4NDhVeEtrUT0= --max-results 10 --role-chain AssumeRoleFor=1015228550060000 RoleType=service RoleArn=acs:ram::1234722338140000:role/aliyunnasclientvsc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas DescribeFilesystemsVscAttachInfo --region cn-hangzhou --RoleChain.1.RoleArn 'acs:ram::1234722338140000:role/aliyunnasclientvsc0000' --NextToken 'TGlzdFJlc291cmNlU0000mVzJjE1MTI2NjY4NzY5MTAzOTEmMiZORnI4NDhVeEtrUT0=' --RoleChain.1.AssumeRoleFor 1015228550060000 --MaxResults 10 --ResourceIds.1.FileSystemId 'bmcpfs-290t15yn4uo8lid0000' --ResourceIds.1.VscId 'vsc-8vb864o3ppwfvh0000' --RoleChain.1.RoleType service --method POST --force
